title: Garlic Sautéed Vegetables (Stovetop)
summary: Following a tablet recipe, the person peels garlic, then preps and dries a nonstick pan before sautéing garlic and greens on the stove and plating.

nodes.name: Review the recipe
nodes.instruction_novice: Read through the recipe on your tablet so you know the ingredients and order.
nodes.end_state: Tablet showing the recipe sits open on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Review the recipe?

nodes.name: Peel the garlic cloves
nodes.instruction_novice: Separate cloves and peel off the papery skin with a knife or your fingers.
nodes.end_state: Clean peeled garlic cloves sit on the counter with skins discarded.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the garlic cloves?

nodes.name: Mince or slice the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Slice or finely chop the peeled garlic on a cutting board.
nodes.end_state: A small pile of minced garlic is on the cutting board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mince or slice the garlic?

nodes.name: Wash and trim the vegetables
nodes.instruction_novice: Rinse the greens and trim off any tough ends, then pat them dry.
nodes.end_state: Trimmed, dry vegetables are on a plate near the stove.

checks.question: Is this step done: Wash and trim the vegetables?

nodes.name: Clean and dry the pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Wipe the pan with a paper towel so it is clean and completely dry.
nodes.end_state: A clean, dry nonstick pan sits on the burner.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clean and dry the pan?

nodes.name: Heat oil in the pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn the burner to medium and add a tablespoon of oil, letting it warm for a minute.
nodes.end_state: Oil shimmers across the bottom of the pan on a lit burner.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat oil in the pan?

nodes.name: Sauté the garlic briefly
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the garlic and stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant, not brown.
nodes.end_state: Garlic is sizzling and pale golden in the oil.

checks.question: Is this step done: Sauté the garlic briefly?

nodes.name: Add and cook the vegetables
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the vegetables and stir often until bright green and just tender.
nodes.end_state: Vegetables are bright green, glossy, and slightly charred in the pan.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add and cook the vegetables?

nodes.name: Season to taste
nodes.instruction_novice: Sprinkle salt and pepper and toss; taste and adjust.
nodes.end_state: Seasoning is visibly distributed over the vegetables.

checks.question: Is this step done: Season to taste?

nodes.name: Turn off heat and plate
nodes.instruction_novice: Switch off the burner and move the vegetables to a serving plate.
nodes.end_state: Cooked vegetables are on a plate and the burner is off.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off heat and plate?
